findings.pattern_name: std::set / std::map with pointer key, default comparator
findings.title: timingInfo* set comparator lacks strict-weak-order / ID tiebreak; drives tight max-tran sinks
findings.description_md: `compareTimInfo` orders `std::set<timingInfo*>` using only fuzzy score compare and `cmpVal <= 0` (not a valid strict weak ordering), with no `getIdLong` / term-id tiebreak. `targetNWorstSinks` (and `identifyTimingCriticalSinks`) iterate this set in comparator order to populate `_tightTransitionSinkPinSet`, which then receives tightened max-transition DRC via `setMaxTransition`. Equal-score sinks therefore compete by unstable set order / UB comparator behavior, changing which pins get tight transition constraints and affecting QoR/area.
findings.downstream_observability_md:
**Suspect:** `_sinkPinTimingInfoSet` ordered by broken `compareTimInfo`.
**Path:** `runTDSinkTargetTransitionRecipe` → (optional) `targetNWorstSinks` when `sortByCriticality` (default true) → inserts first N into `_tightTransitionSinkPinSet` → `setMaxTransition(false,false)` applies DRC.
**Sink:** design constraint mutation (`drcMgr` / max-transition) and subsequent buffering/sizing QoR.
**Also:** `identifyTimingCriticalSinks` walks the same set for criticality membership.
findings.controls_md: Timing-driven sink transition recipe on CTS scheduling path (`runTDSinkTargetTransitionRecipe`). Gated by TD sink-tran options; `sortByCriticality` defaults **true** (`getTDsinkTranOption("sortByCriticality", true)`).
findings.app_option_defaults_md:
- `sortByCriticality` (TD sink tran): default **true** — enables N-worst selection from the set.
- Related: `TransRatioMultiplier`, `sortAllNegativeAreaPenalty`, `degradationAverse` (default true).
findings.regression_setting_md: Not exhaustively traced in `nwtn/unit` from this local CTS mirror; production default enables the N-worst path.
findings.performance_note_md: Add O(1) `getIdLong()` / `compareObjPtr` tiebreak in the comparator. Do not replace the set with a full vector+sort inside the inner sink loop; fixing the comparator is cheapest and preserves logarithmic insert.

fix_versions.label: Version A (Simple)
Version B (Robust)

findings.rationale_md: Version A restores a valid strict weak order and deterministic tiebreak with negligible cost. Version B is useful if the set is also used for non-order-sensitive membership and you want ranking isolated to the N-worst boundary.
findings.false_positive_check_md: Not membership-only: set iteration selects which sinks receive max-tran. Comparator uses `<= 0` (invalid SWO) and has no identity tiebreak. Neutralizer absent before `setMaxTransition`.
findings.ownership_md:
- **Depot:** not resolved — local CTS tree; `p4` client/tools unavailable on this host.
- **Attribution skipped:** Stage 4b requires Perforce annotate/describe.

findings.pattern_name: std::set / std::map with pointer key, default comparator
findings.title: Pointer-ordered std::set<ndmNet*> last-driver return under MLPH multi-net leaf path
findings.description_md: `msDriversOptions::_loadNetSet` is allocated as `new std::set<ndmNet*>()` (default address comparator) at ~10309. In `msClockDrivers::findDriverTerm`, when `enableMLPHFlow && loadNetSet->size()>1 && leafLevel`, the function walks nets in pointer order, inserts drivers into a stable `termSetType`, but **returns the last overwritten `l_drvTerm`**. Callers that use the returned term (not only `drvTerms`) for `getAClockOnTerm` / tap configuration can therefore pick different drivers across runs.
findings.downstream_observability_md:
**Suspect:** address-ordered `_loadNetSet` + last-wins return.
**Callers:** `msAutoTapFlow.cc` (~4477 dummy `drvTerms`, ~5190, ~6194) uses returned `drvTerm` for `getAClockOnTerm`, sink collection, `evaluateTapConfiguration`.
**Sink:** clock selection and tap topology / QoR under MLPH.
**Partial neutralizer:** `drvTerms` itself is `termSetType` (`ndmObjPtrCmpType`); defect is specifically the scalar return.
findings.controls_md: Requires `enable_mlph_flow` (**default false**, MSUI_BASIC), `_loadNetSet` with >1 net, and `leafLevel==true`.
findings.app_option_defaults_md:
- `enable_mlph_flow` (`msuiAppOptions`): default **false**, BASIC visibility.
- Related: `enable_mlph_flow_old` (INTERNAL, default false), `enable_mim_support` forced true when MLPH enabled.
findings.regression_setting_md: MLPH/tap flows that set `enable_mlph_flow` true and pass multi-net leaf loads.
findings.performance_note_md: Prefer `std::set<ndmNet*, ndmObjPtrCmpType>` (or `ndmPtrSet`) for `_loadNetSet`, and/or return a deterministic pick from `drvTerms` (`*drvTerms.begin()` / `getTopLevelDrvTerm`). Insert cost remains O(log n) with small n (load nets).

fix_versions.label: Version A (Simple)
Version B (Robust)

findings.rationale_md: Version A fixes both container order and return selection with project idioms already used for `termSetType`. Severity MEDIUM because the path is gated by `enable_mlph_flow` defaulting false.
findings.false_positive_check_md: Confirmed default `std::set<ndmNet*>` allocation; MLPH branch iterates and returns last driver; production callers consume return for clock/tap decisions. Not membership-only.
findings.ownership_md:
- **Depot:** not resolved — local CTS tree; `p4` unavailable.
- **Attribution skipped:** Stage 4b requires Perforce.

dismissed_buckets.bucket_label: Two-arg std::sort on numeric/ID/tuple types (not pointer vectors)
dismissed_buckets.rationale_md: Of ~401 production 1.1 hits, ~312 already pass a custom comparator; remaining ~83 two-arg sorts are predominantly float/int/ID/tuple containers (pathDelays, coefficients, msg ids, grid coords). Zero confirmed pointer-vector sorts without comparator promoted.

dismissed_buckets.bucket_label: Pointer set/map membership-only or already ndmObjPtrCmpType
dismissed_buckets.rationale_md: ~2450 hits already show stable comparators; remaining suspects are mostly find/insert/count, boolean membership loops, or typedefs like `termSetType`. Examples: splitStateDrivers, NodeList, _processedGroups, marked_insts.

dismissed_buckets.bucket_label: Pointer unordered_* lookup/visited or post-sort neutralized
dismissed_buckets.rationale_md: Caches/visited sets and maps; or vectorize+`sort(compareObjPtr)` before observable use (e.g. soLogicCone LUT). soClockGateOpt fromToMap iteration is report-order only → severity LOW (excluded by HIGH/MEDIUM floor).

dismissed_buckets.bucket_label: Pointer hash functors used as membership/lookup caches
dismissed_buckets.rationale_md: soLogicCone caches, ctscstrDesign concurrent_hash_map, ctoscFilter module cost cache: find/insert only. sclkCornerHash LoadPartition iteration is commutative weighted average — not promoted.

dismissed_buckets.bucket_label: Random/seed sites are test-only or fixed-seed deterministic
dismissed_buckets.rationale_md: `srand(time(NULL))` only in DisjointSet test drivers. Production `ccdcgSolver::srand(100)` and default `mt19937` in msClustering are fixed-seed (not equivalent-run ND). `*RandomTest.cc` harnesses only.

dismissed_buckets.bucket_label: Time-based seeds only in test/dead paths
getFullName used as deterministic tiebreak / diagnostics
dismissed_buckets.rationale_md: Glanced hot sites; name used as stable string order tiebreak or reporting, not unstable algorithm map keys on QoR path.

dismissed_buckets.bucket_label: Tier-2 vicinity / concurrency seeds not promoted without MT proof
dismissed_buckets.rationale_md: Patterns 3.2–3.7 and 4.1–4.4 dominate Stage-1 volume as vicinity/seed hits. After narrowing + spot checks (dosMap thread-safe cache comment; mutable _leafCount without proven concurrent const readers), none elevated to HIGH/MEDIUM real for this report.

module_specific_summary_md: CTS already adopts `ndmObjPtrCmpType` / `termSetType` widely, which neutralized the majority of pointer-container scanner hits. The remaining HIGH issue is a broken score-only set comparator on the timing-driven sink max-tran recipe; the MEDIUM issue is MLPH-gated last-driver selection from an address-ordered net set. Random/time seeds and most unordered maps are test-only, fixed-seed, or membership-only.
fix_recipes_excerpt_md: Prefer `ndmPtrMap` / `ndmObjPtrCmpType` / `ndmObjectHandleNS::compareObjPtr` over raw `std::less<T*>`. For ranking, use strict `<` on the metric then stable ID tiebreak. Canonicalize unordered iteration at the smallest observable boundary (before mutation/report), not by converting every hot lookup map to `std::map`.
